{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (should be 6, but found 0)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print("QA orders found:", len(qa_orders))

# Filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check if any LOYAL completed orders exist
print("Number of LOYAL completed orders:", len(loyal_completed))

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from LOYAL customers: {mean_revenue}")"}
